summary: Multiple uncontained chemicals and automotive fluids stored openly in work zone.

hazards.title: Open Shelf Flammable Liquids
hazards.detail: Automotive oils and fluids stored on open shelves increase workshop fire risk.
fixSteps: Move flammable oils to a dedicated metal safety cabinet.
Keep storage separated from active heat or electrical sources.

hazards.title: Unsecured Chemical Containers
hazards.detail: Bottles of vehicle fluids stored on open shelving risk accidental spills or leaks.
fixSteps: Store fluids in a closed chemical cabinet with secondary containment.
Check caps and seals tightly after every use.

hazards.title: Floor Fluid Jug Obstruction
hazards.detail: Fluid container resting near floor walkway poses a low-level trip and kick hazard.
fixSteps: Elevate jugs onto designated shelves away from walkways.
Keep clear minimum clearance around vehicle workspace.

products.name: Flammable Storage Cabinet
products.reason: Safely encloses combustible oils and chemicals to mitigate fire risks.

products.name: Spill Containment Tray
products.reason: Catches accidental leaks from fluid jugs and spray bottles.
